Below is a **complete, step‑by‑step guide** you can follow to build a modern, production‑ready frontend for an e‑commerce site. It covers everything from planning and design to deployment and monitoring, and it’s written so you can copy‑paste the snippets into your own project. --- ## 1. Planning & Design | Step | What to do | Why it matters | |------|------------|----------------| | **Define core features** | Product catalog, search, filters, cart, checkout, user account, reviews, admin panel, analytics, PWA support | Keeps scope focused | | **Create user personas** | Shopper, admin, guest | Guides UX decisions | | **Sketch wireframes** | Use Figma/Sketch | Visualise layout early | | **Build a design system** | Colors, typography, spacing, components | Consistency & speed | | **Decide on tech stack** | React + Vite + TypeScript + Tailwind + Zustand + React‑Query + Next.js (SSR) | Modern, fast, SEO friendly | > **Tip:** Keep the design system in a separate repo or a monorepo package so you can reuse it across projects. --- ## 2. Project Skeleton ```bash # Create a new Next.js app (React + SSR) npx create-next-app@latest ecommerce-frontend --typescript cd ecommerce-frontend ``` ### Folder structure ``` ecommerce-frontend/ ├─ public/ # Static assets ├─ src/ │ ├─ components/ # Reusable UI components │ ├─ pages/ # Next.js pages (routes) │ ├─ hooks/ # Custom hooks │ ├─ lib/ # API clients, utilities │ ├─ store/ # Zustand store │ ├─ styles/ # Tailwind config, global CSS │ ├─ types/ # TypeScript types │ └─ utils/ # Helpers ├─ .env.local # Environment variables ├─ .gitignore ├─ package.json ├─ tailwind.config.js └─ tsconfig.json ``` --- ## 3. Core Dependencies ```bash # UI & styling npm i tailwindcss postcss autoprefixer npx tailwindcss init -p # State & data fetching npm i zustand react-query # Routing & SSR npm i next react react-dom # Testing npm i -D jest @testing-library/react @testing-library/jest-dom @testing-library/user-event cypress # Linting & formatting npm i -D eslint prettier eslint-config-prettier eslint-plugin-react eslint-plugin-react-hooks eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y # CI/CD npm i -D husky lint-staged ``` --- ## 4. Tailwind Setup `tailwind.config.js` ```js module.exports = { content: [ "./src/**/*.{js,ts,jsx,tsx}", ], theme: { extend: {}, }, plugins: [], } ``` `src/styles/globals.css` ```css @tailwind base; @tailwind components; @tailwind utilities; ``` Add the global CSS to `_app.tsx`: ```tsx import '@/styles/globals.css' ``` --- ## 5. API Client (React‑Query + Axios) `src/lib/api.ts` ```ts import axios from 'axios' const api = axios.create({ baseURL: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', }, }) export default api ``` `src/hooks/useProducts.ts` ```ts import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query' import api from '@/lib/api' export const fetchProducts = async () => { const { data } = await api.get('/products') return data } export const useProducts = () => { return useQuery(['products'], fetchProducts) } ``` --- ## 6. Global State (Zustand) `src/store/cartStore.ts` ```ts import create from 'zustand' export interface CartItem { id: string name: string price: number quantity: number image: string } interface CartState { items: CartItem[] addItem: (item: CartItem) => void removeItem: (id: string) => void clearCart: () => void } export const useCartStore = create((set) => ({ items: [], addItem: (item) => set((state) => { const existing = state.items.find((i) => i.id === item.id) if (existing) { return { items: state.items.map((i) => i.id === item.id ? { ...i, quantity: i.quantity + 1 } : i ), } } return { items: [...state.items, item] } }), removeItem: (id) => set((state) => ({ items: state.items.filter((i) => i.id !== id), })), clearCart: () => set({ items: [] }), })) ``` --- ## 7. Sample Page – Product Listing `src/pages/index.tsx` ```tsx import { useProducts } from '@/hooks/useProducts' import { useCartStore } from '@/store/cartStore' import Image from 'next/image' export default function Home() { const { data, isLoading, error } = useProducts() const addToCart = useCartStore((state) => state.addItem) if (isLoading) return

Loading…

if (error) return

Something went wrong.

return (
{data?.map((product) => (

{product.name}

${product.price}

))}
) } ``` --- ## 8. Cart Sidebar `src/components/CartSidebar.tsx` ```tsx import { useCartStore } from '@/store/cartStore' import Link from 'next/link' export default function CartSidebar() { const { items, clearCart } = useCartStore() const total = items.reduce((sum, i) => sum + i.price * i.quantity, 0) return (

Shopping Cart

{items.length === 0 ? (

Your cart is empty.

) : ( <>
    {items.map((item) => (
  • {item.name} × {item.quantity} ${(item.price * item.quantity).toFixed(2)}
    • ))}
Total: ${total.toFixed(2)}
Proceed to Checkout )}
) } ``` Add the sidebar to `_app.tsx` so it’s always present: ```tsx import CartSidebar from '@/components/CartSidebar' export default function App({ Component, pageProps }) { return ( <> ) } ``` --- ## 9. Checkout Page (Skeleton) `src/pages/checkout.tsx` ```tsx import { useCartStore } from '@/store/cartStore' import { useState } from 'react' export default function Checkout() { const { items, clearCart } = useCartStore() const [isSubmitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false) const handleSubmit = async (e) => { e.preventDefault() setSubmitting(true) // TODO: Call payment gateway await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 2000)) clearCart() setSubmitting(false) alert('Order placed!') } return (

Checkout

{/* Billing / Shipping form fields */}
{/* ... more fields ... */}
) } ``` --- ## 10. Accessibility & SEO | Feature | Implementation | |---------|----------------| | **Semantic HTML** | Use `
`, `
`, `
`, `
` | | **ARIA labels** | `aria-label="Add to cart"` on buttons | | **Keyboard navigation** | Ensure focus states (`focus:outline-none`) | | **Meta tags** | In `_document.tsx` or `next/head` | | **Structured data** | JSON‑LD for products (`next/script` with `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`) | | **Image optimization** | `next/image` automatically optimizes | --- ## 11. Testing ### Unit / Component Tests (Jest + React Testing Library) `src/__tests__/ProductCard.test.tsx` ```tsx import { render, screen, fireEvent } from '@testing-library/react' import ProductCard from '@/components/ProductCard' import { useCartStore } from '@/store/cartStore' jest.mock('@/store/cartStore') const mockAdd = jest.fn() useCartStore.mockReturnValue({ addItem: mockAdd }) test('renders product card and adds to cart', () => { render( ) fireEvent.click(screen.getByText(/add to cart/i)) expect(mockAdd).toHaveBeenCalledWith( expect.objectContaining({ id: '1', name: 'Test Product' }) ) }) ``` ### End‑to‑End Tests (Cypress) `cypress/integration/cart.spec.js` ```js describe('Cart flow', () => { it('adds a product to cart and proceeds to checkout', () => { cy.visit('/') cy.contains('Add to cart').click() cy.get('[data-testid=cart-sidebar]').should('be.visible') cy.contains('Proceed to Checkout').click() cy.url().should('include', '/checkout') }) }) ``` --- ## 12. CI/CD Pipeline (GitHub Actions) `.github/workflows/ci.yml` ```yaml name: CI on: push: branches: [main] pull_request: jobs: build-test: runs-on: ubuntu-latest steps: - uses: actions/checkout@v4 - uses: actions/setup-node@v4 with: node-version: '20' - run: npm ci - run: npm run lint - run: npm run test - run: npm run build ``` **Deploy to Vercel** – simply connect the repo; Vercel will run the same build script. --- ## 13. Performance Optimisation | Technique | How to implement | |-----------|------------------| | **Code splitting** | Next.js automatically splits pages | | **Lazy load images** | `next/image` with `loading="lazy"` | | **Prefetch routes** | `next/link` with `prefetch={true}` | | **Cache API responses** | React‑Query cacheTime + staleTime | | **Service worker** | `next-pwa` plugin | | **Bundle analysis** | `next-bundle-analyzer` | --- ## 14. Security | Concern | Mitigation | |---------|------------| | **XSS** | Escape all user input, use `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` sparingly | | **CSRF** | Use SameSite cookies, CSRF tokens for POST | | **Payment data** | Never store raw card numbers; use Stripe Elements or similar | | **Auth** | JWT + refresh tokens, secure HTTPOnly cookies | --- ## 15. Monitoring & Analytics | Tool | Purpose | |------|---------| | **Sentry** | Error tracking | | **Google Analytics / Plausible** | User behaviour | | **LogRocket** | Session replay | | **Vercel Analytics** | Build & deployment metrics | --- ## 16. Checklist Before Launch - [ ] Responsive design (mobile‑first) - [ ] Accessibility audit (axe, Lighthouse) - [ ] SEO meta tags & structured data - [ ] PWA manifest & service worker - [ ] Payment gateway integration (Stripe/PayPal) - [ ] Email notifications (SendGrid, SES) - [ ] CI/CD pipeline - [ ] Performance budget (Lighthouse score ≥ 90) - [ ] Security hardening (HTTPS, CSP, HSTS) --- ## 17. Resources | Topic | Link | |-------|------| | Next.js Docs | https://nextjs.org/docs | | Tailwind Docs | https://tailwindcss.com/docs | | Zustand Docs | https://docs.pmnd.rs/zustand | | React‑Query Docs | https://react-query.tanstack.com/ | | Cypress Docs | https://docs.cypress.io/ | | ESLint + Prettier | https://eslint.org/docs/latest/use/configure | | Vercel Docs | https://vercel.com/docs | --- ### Final Thought Start small: get a single product page working, then add cart, checkout, and finally admin features. Keep the code modular, test often, and iterate on UX based on real user feedback. Happy coding!
